headline: US-Israel drew up detailed post-midterm strike plans on Iran ('short but intensive')
dek: US and Israeli militaries drew up detailed plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the Nov 3 US midterms — a 'short but intensive' operation (possibly ~3 days) targeting energy sites, nuclear facilities, missile/drone arsenals; some officials believe it could push Iran's economy over the brink.…
fault_line: Will a 3-day campaign force Tehran to concede — or trigger Iran's 'father of all bombs' and data-center/undersea-cable retaliation?
